uncovered_constraints_packaged: R08 owns only the targeted PMC and traffic/resource stage and consumes only the exact same-run R01-R07 prefix in workflow01-10-fresh-e2e.
The outer scheduler alone creates the formal R08 Goal; the project skill creates no nested Goal, invokes no Adapt or project skill, and starts no successor.
The pinned target is inspection-bound and immutable; Python source and system ABI extensions have separate provenance gates.
The authoritative workload is the row-zero 16-32K batch with two warmups and eight measured requests at concurrency eight, and every replay keeps that contract.
Every evidence-acquiring replay preserves physical devices 0 and 1, DP ranks 0 and 1, world size two, TP1, PP1, DP2 mp, native profiler identity, and per-rank/per-device artifacts.
R06's complete family inventory, selected bounded plan, literal bytes, selection/exclusion state, applicability, budgets, and counter prerequisites are independently revalidated before replay.
R07 non-replay request/process/runtime/kernel time is the only observed latency axis; all R08 replay counters and traffic/resource attributes remain replay_projected or explicitly derived.

A standalone CPU-only predevice gate validates source/profile/prefix hashes, project-relative path semantics, R02 root containment, launcher argv, legal missing parents, executable mode, frozen tools, and literal-to-token production behavior.
R02_R08 path separation is explicit: mandatory R08_R02_ROOT and byte-exact --r02-root/--r02-inventory never reuse the R08 artifact root.
The CPU gate, formal device/capability preflight, and replay are separate tool calls with sealed checkpoints.
HIPProf receives a binary-equivalent simplified collector token; plans, ownership, analysis, and the model retain the exact full demangled literal.

Token collisions or empirically ineffective filtering create bounded supersets whose non-target raw rows are preserved and whose logical rows require full range/launch/correlation/subsequence post-filtering.
Current gfx936 counter capability records native names, formulas, units, tool/environment provenance, and explicit available, unavailable, or blocking unknown states.

Every accepted physical capture has exit zero, required nonempty DB/PMC outputs, eight successful measured requests, both ranks/devices, exact lifecycle counts, a sealed manifest, and device-release proof.
The exact attribution chain rejects token equality, substring matching, replay time overlap, row proximity, and shared raw membership as ownership evidence.
The traffic/resource model is FX-visible, formula- and unit-pinned, lineage-bound, per-rank/per-device, availability-aware, and independently audited for nested/shared-row conservation.
The canonical wrong-R02-root attempt and the raw-literal, escaped-literal, and regex HIPProf attempts remain diagnostic-only and cannot contribute counters or timing.
Prelaunch failures preserve the same logical capture ordinal and attempt name through a new immutable driver revision while retaining zero lifecycle counts and old diagnostics.

Before any accepted capture, ordinary scheduler resume allocates a new empty R08 root; after an accepted prefix, same-root suffix-only resume validates and skips the prefix and uses new empty attempts.
A blocked formal Goal never uses --continue-current-goal, never reruns A01-A11 or R01-R07, and never degrades to an accepted-prefix or full-stage rerun when integrity cannot be proven.
Valid raw captures are not repeated for CPU normalization/audit defects; partial outputs remain isolated and repairs use persistent processes and new normalized-repair roots.
R08 produces device_capabilities, targeted_pmc_manifest, traffic_resource_model, and source_lineage with paths and hashes, and writes business outputs separately from the scheduler handoff.
Execution completion, evidence sufficiency, coverage, capability-proven unavailability, and next authorization remain separate; R09 advances only on the complete evidence gate.
Known large builder/normalizer/auditor generation requires two consecutive fully stagnant five-minute observations before only a cmdline-verified scheduler PID may be interrupted.
The skill and this Adapt handoff are migration products and do not constitute R08 or performance-workflow execution.
